name: Biometric Attendance Log
report_script:
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")
employee = filters.get("employee")
is_processed = filters.get("is_processed")

if is_processed:
    if is_processed == "Yes":
        is_processed = "Y"
    if is_processed == "No":
        is_processed = "N"
    if is_processed == "Error":
        is_processed = "E"

columns = [
    {
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Employee",
        "fieldname": "employee_id",
        "label": "Employee Id"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Date",
        "fieldname": "punch_date",
        "label": "Punch Date"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "fieldname": "punch_time",
        "label": "Punch Time"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "fieldname": "area",
        "label": "Area"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "fieldname": "terminal_id",
        "label": "Machine Id"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "fieldname": "punch_direction",
        "label": "Punch Direction"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "fieldname": "is_processed",
        "label": "Is Processed"
    },
    {
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Employee Checkin",
        "fieldname": "message",
        "label": "Message"
    }
    
]

conditions = ""
employee_cond = ""
is_processed_cond = ""

if employee:
    employee_cond = f" AND employee_id = '{employee}'"

if is_processed:
    is_processed_cond = f" AND is_processed = '{is_processed}'"

conditions = f"{conditions} {employee_cond} {is_processed_cond}"

sql = f"""
    SELECT
    name,
    employee_id,
    punch_time,
    punch_date,
    area,
    terminal_id,
    punch_direction,
    is_processed,
    message
    -- shift_type
FROM
    bio_attendance_log
WHERE
    punch_date between '{from_date}' and '{to_date}' {conditions}
    AND LENGTH(employee_id) >= 5
"""

result = frappe.db.sql(sql, as_dict=True)

data = columns, result

            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Conveyance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) conveyance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Canteen Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) canteen_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Children Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) children_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Education Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) education_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'House Rent Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) house_rent_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Special Pay' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) special_pay_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Washing Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) washing_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Over Time' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) over_time_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Incentives' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) incentive_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Local Transport Allowance' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) transport_allowance_alotted,
            MAX(CASE WHEN sd.salary_component = 'Other Benefits' THEN sd.amount ELSE 0 END) misc_alotted
        FROM
            `tabSalary Structure` sst
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabSalary Detail` sd ON sd.parent = sst.name
        WHERE
            sst.name = '{sst_name}'
    """, as_dict=True)
    for i in salary_structure_sql:
        res["earned_basic_alotted"] = i["earned_basic_alotted"]
        res["conveyance_alotted"] = i["conveyance_alotted"]
        res["canteen_allowance_alotted"] = i["canteen_allowance_alotted"]
        res["children_allowance_alotted"] = i["children_allowance_alotted"]
        res["education_allowance_alotted"] = i["education_allowance_alotted"]
        res["house_rent_allowance_alotted"] = i["house_rent_allowance_alotted"]
        res["special_pay_alotted"] = i["special_pay_alotted"]
        res["washing_allowance_alotted"] = i["washing_allowance_alotted"]
        res["over_time_alotted"] = i["over_time_alotted"]
        res["incentive_alotted"] = i["incentive_alotted"]
        res["transport_allowance_alotted"] = i["transport_allowance_alotted"]
        res["misc_alotted"] = i["misc_alotted"]
      
        
    holiday_sql = frappe.db.sql(f"""
        SELECT
            (CASE WHEN h.description <> 'Sunday' THEN h.holiday_date ELSE 0 END) AS holiday,
            (CASE WHEN h.description = 'Sunday' THEN h.holiday_date ELSE 0 END) AS w_off,
            h.holiday_date,
            e.name
        FROM
            `tabHoliday List` hl
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabEmployee` e ON e.holiday_list = hl.name
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabHoliday` h ON hl.name = h.parent
        WHERE
            e.name = '{res["emp"]}'
            AND h.holiday_date BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}'
        GROUP BY
            h.holiday_date
    """, as_dict = True)
            
    
    if holiday_sql:
        for h in holiday_sql:
            res["holiday"] = h["holiday"]
            res["week_off"] = h["holiday"]
    result.append(res)
    
data = columns, result

            {conditions}

            elif data["out_time"] < data["in_time"] and data["custom_end_across_days"] == 1:
                twenty_four_hour = frappe.utils.get_timedelta("24:00:00")
                hours = data["out_time"] + twenty_four_hour - data["in_time"]
                data["worked_hours"] = hours
                if frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= full_day:
                    data["attendance"] = "Present"
                elif full_day >= frappe.utils.get_time(hours) >= half_day:
                    data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                else:
                    data["attendance"] = "Absent"
        
            """ Marking Late Chekin """
            
            if data["shift_start_time"] and data["in_time"]:
                late_entry_difference = data["in_time"] - data["shift_start_time"]
                late_entry_difference_seconds = late_entry_difference.total_seconds()
                f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_in.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_in.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_in.second
                if late_entry_difference_seconds > f_seconds :
                    data["late_entry"] = "Yes"
                    employee_name = data["employee_name"]
                
                    consecutive_late_entries[employee_name] = consecutive_late_entries.get(employee_name, 0) + 1
        
                    if consecutive_late_entries[employee_name] > 3:
                        data["attendance"] = "Half Day"
                else:
                    data["late_entry"] = "No"
                    consecutive_late_entries[data["employee_name"]] = 0
            
            """ Marking Early Checkout """
            
            if data["shift_end_time"] and data["out_time"]:
                early_exit_difference = data["shift_end_time"] - data["out_time"]
                early_exit_difference_seconds = early_exit_difference.total_seconds()
                f_seconds = fifteen_minutes_out.hour * 3600 + fifteen_minutes_out.minute * 60 + fifteen_minutes_out.second
                if early_exit_difference_seconds > f_seconds :
                    data["early_exit"] = "Yes"
                else:
                    data["early_exit"] = "No"
            
            
            if str(data["date"]) != first_day_next_month:
                result.append(data)
            
    
for i in result:
    if i["in_time"] is None and i["out_time"] is None:
        result.remove(i)

data = columns, result
